title: Tofu Tagine
description: A North African-inspired dish that combines the flavors of quietly-spiced tofu with the umami taste of Chinese fermented bean paste. This tagine is a hearty and comforting meal.
instructions: Heat the quietly-spiced oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Chinese fermented bean paste, chicken broth, and tagine spice blend. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until the tofu is coated in the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over couscous or rice.
